text: dukkhaṃ yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ . vedanā aniccā . saññā aniccā . saṅkhārā aniccā . viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ . evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato pubbantānudiṭṭhiyo na honti pubbantānudiṭṭhīnaṃ asati
